description: Compare two versions of an OpenAPI contract before you change an API or upgrade to a new version of one. Returns a verdict (safe / review / block), a suggested semver bump, and every change classified breaking / potentially_breaking / unknown / compatible / non_contract, with evidence and a recommended fix. Pass `uses` (the operations your code calls) to filter the findings to those operations; Breakra does not read your code. Deterministic; runs locally.

after.description: The new contract. An OpenAPI 3.0.x or 3.1.x document: a JSON object, or the whole document as JSON or YAML text. Inline only; URLs are not fetched.

before.description: The current contract. An OpenAPI 3.0.x or 3.1.x document: a JSON object, or the whole document as JSON or YAML text. Inline only; URLs are not fetched.

uses.description: Optional: operations your code calls, e.g. [{"method":"GET","path":"/orders/{id}"}].

name: check_openapi_change
title: Check an OpenAPI change for breaking changes
